summary.short: Vietnamese statute No. 71/2025/QH15 on the digital technology industry, issued by the National Assembly on 14 June 2025, effective 1 January 2026. The fetched page contains only title and publication metadata; operative provisions are absent.
summary.long: Law No. 71/2025/QH15 on the digital technology industry (Luật Công nghiệp công nghệ số), issued by the National Assembly (QUỐC HỘI) on 14/06/2025 and signed by Trần Thanh Mẫn, takes effect on 01/01/2026 according to the page metadata, and was published in Công báo issues 965 and 966. The supplied document is a government gazette web page showing the title, issuing body, dates, document type and navigation elements. It contains no article text, so the scope, obligations, thresholds, sanctions and definitions the law may set out are not recorded. Classification is limited to the binding statutory form and the issuing body. Domains, mechanisms and roles are left empty because no operative provision was available to support them.

notes: The document is the congbao.chinhphu.vn portal page for Law 71/2025/QH15 and does not contain the law's operative text. Metadata shows issued 14/06/2025, effective 01/01/2026, signatory Trần Thanh Mẫn, Công báo 965+966. The page's relation panel shows [0] for every category (basis, amendment, replacement, guidance, cross-reference), so no relations are recorded. Relations stated in the law's own text were not checked and may exist.
